t: Handy pack of extreme impact torsion bits. Supplied in a tough, small bulk storage case that fits easily in the pocket. CNC-machined to ensure less than 4° movement for a better fit, eliminating stripped screws. Creates more surface area, meaning increased friction and less slippage. Supplied with magnetic bit holder. Compatible with DEWALT TSTAK caddy.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
